metadata.question: Was the NVDI lower in northern Kenya than in southern Kenya during May-June 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) for NDVI calculation in 2019 - Time: May-June 2019 (2019-05-01 to 2019-06-30) - Location: Need to define two geometries - northern Kenya and southern Kenya - Kenya spans roughly: Latitude -4.5° to 4.5°, Longitude 34° to 42° - Northern Kenya: above equator (0° to 4.5°N) - Southern Kenya: below equator (-4.5° to 0°S) 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, need to mask clouds using QA60 band for Sentinel-2 - NDVI question requires valid pixels, not cloud coverage 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid NDVI range: -1 to 1 - Zero or low NDVI is valid (could indicate bare soil, water) - Check for None/null results → C3 - Check for empty collection → C1 - Check for zero valid pixels after masking → C2 - Compare northern vs southern: if north < south → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const northernKenya = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[34, 0], [42, 0], [42, 4.5], [34, 4.5], [34, 0]] ]); const southernKenya = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[34, -4.5], [42, -4.5], [42, 0], [34, 0], [34, -4.5]] ]); const startDate = '2019-05-01'; const endDate = '2019-06-30'; // 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Data Acquisition for Northern Kenya let colNorth = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(northernKenya) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(maskS2clouds); const sizeNorth = colNorth.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Northern Kenya Images: ${sizeNorth}`); if (sizeNorth === 0) { // Try Landsat 8 as fallback colNorth = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(northernKenya) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(function(img) { const cloudMask = img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0); return img.updateMask(cloudMask); }); const sizeNorthL8 = colNorth.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Northern Kenya Landsat Images: ${sizeNorthL8}`); if (sizeNorthL8 === 0) { console.log('No data for Northern Kenya.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 4. Data Acquisition for Southern Kenya let colSouth = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(southernKenya) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(maskS2clouds); const sizeSouth = colSouth.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Southern Kenya Images: ${sizeSouth}`); if (sizeSouth === 0) { colSouth = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(southernKenya) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(function(img) { const cloudMask = img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0); return img.updateMask(cloudMask); }); const sizeSouthL8 = colSouth.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Southern Kenya Landsat Images: ${sizeSouthL8}`); if (sizeSouthL8 === 0) { console.log('No data for Southern Kenya.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 5. Calculate NDVI and create composites function addNDVI(image) { let ndvi; if (image.bandNames().contains('B8').getInfo()) { // Sentinel-2 ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); } else { // Landsat 8 ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); } return image.addBands(ndvi); } const northComposite = colNorth.map(addNDVI).select('NDVI').median(); const southComposite = colSouth.map(addNDVI).select('NDVI').median(); // 6. Calculate mean NDVI and pixel counts const statsNorth = northComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: northernKenya, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const statsSouth = southComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: southernKenya, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const ndviNorth = statsNorth['NDVI_mean']; const countNorth = statsNorth['NDVI_count']; const ndviSouth = statsSouth['NDVI_mean']; const countSouth = statsSouth['NDVI_count']; console.log(`Northern Kenya NDVI: ${ndviNorth}, Pixels: ${countNorth}`); console.log(`Southern Kenya NDVI: ${ndviSouth}, Pixels: ${countSouth}`); // 7. Validation & Final Answer if (countNorth === 0 || countSouth === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (ndviNorth === null || ndviSouth === null || ndviNorth < -1 || ndviNorth > 1 || ndviSouth < -1 || ndviSouth > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (ndviNorth < ndviSouth) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
